C0429.title: Xiangtan Police Dismantle Cyber-Enabled Mafia-Like Groups Extorting via Negative Public Opinion
C0429.summary: During the Summer Action campaign since June 2023, Xiangtan police dismantled a cyber-enabled organized crime group led by Pan that used negative public opinion for extortion and another group led by Zhang Long that used malicious complaints for extortion. Police arrested 13 suspects and solved 18 cases, helping curb the spread of organized crime into cyberspace.
